title: IGNITION COIL COMPONENTS FOR REMOVAL AND INSTALLATION
ocr_text:
IG–26
IGNITION SYSTEM – 2JZ–GTE

IGNITION COIL
COMPONENTS FOR REMOVAL AND
INSTALLATION

No.3 Timing Belt Cover
Oil Filter Cap
x 10
Ignition Coil
Bracket
Boot
PCV Hose

P18699

IGNITION COILS REMOVAL
Installation is in the reverse order of removal.
1. REMOVE NO.3 TIMING BELT COVER
(a) Remove the oil filler cap.
(b) Using a 5 mm hexagon wrench, remove the 10 bolts, belt cover and gasket.

P11585

2. REMOVE PCV HOSES
Remove the 2 PCV hoses.
3. DISCONNECT IGNITION COIL CONNECTORS
(a) Disconnect the engine wire from the 6 clamps on the ignition coils.
(b) Disconnect the 6 ignition coil connectors.

P11590
